# ANALYSIS CONFIGURATION
## Loading required libraries and custom functions
```{r configuration, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load required libraries
libraries2load = c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "pheatmap",
                 "RColorBrewer", "org.Mm.eg.db", "ggrepel", "readxl", "stringr",
                 "gridExtra", "limma", "DEP", "vsn", "mixOmics",
                 "EnhancedVolcano", "enrichR", "ReactomePA", "clusterProfiler",
                 "pathview", "enrichplot", "DOSE", "AnnotationDbi", "circlize",
                 "ComplexHeatmap", "ggnewscale", "SummarizedExperiment",
                 "stats", "org.Hs.eg.db", "tidytable", "Orthology.eg.db",
                 "homologene", "HPAanalyze", "UniProt.ws", "fgsea", "tidyverse",
                 "purrr", "eulerr", "variancePartition", "BiocParallel",
                 "circlize", "grid", "here","brglm2", "multcomp", "DiscreteFDR",
                 "simplifyEnrichment", "tidytext")

lapply(libraries2load, library, character.only = TRUE)


# Set working directory
pipelineFolder = dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
setwd(pipelineFolder)

# Load custom functions
source("./Functions/DatabaseGenerationFunctions.R")
source("./Functions/EnrichmentAnalysisFunctions.R")
source("./Functions/ModifiedDEPFunctions.R")
source("./Functions/NewFunctionsforDEP.R")
```

## Setting Data Formatting Parameters
```{r dataFormatParameters, include=FALSE}
# Preprocessing setup
col_range_BrainEVData = 1:5
col_range_HumanData = 1:5

row_range_BrainEVData = 3:42
row_range_HumanData = 3:63

sampleNameColumns = 1
proteinNameColumns = 1
samplesIdentifier = "_"

primaryProteinID = "Primary.Gene.name"
secondaryProteinID = "Ids"

metaColNames_BrainEVData = c("Sample", "Group", "Genotype", "EVs", "Age")
metaColNames_HumanData = c("Sample", "Group", "Genotype", "EVs", "Age")

relevelVariables_BrainEVData = data.frame(Group = "WT_sEVs_2m",
                                          Genotype = "Ctrl",
                                          EVs = "sEV",
                                          Age = "2m")
relevelVariables_HumanData = data.frame(Group = "AD_F1_12m",
                                        Genotype = "AD",
                                        EVs = "F1",
                                        Age = "12m")
```

## Setting Factorial Enrichment Analysis Parameters
```{r enrichmentParameters, echo=FALSE}
# Define the formula for the multiple linear models for each analysis
formulades_BrainEVData = formula(~ 0 + EVs * Age * Genotype)
formulades_HumanData = formula(~ 0 + EVs)

# Define the contrast formula for each multiple linear model analysis
contrastFormula_BrainEVData = list(
  sEV_2m_AD_vs_sEV_2m_Ctrl   = 
    quote(GenotypeAD),
  sEV_12m_Ctrl_vs_sEV_2m_Ctrl =
    quote(Age12m),
  sEV_12m_AD_vs_sEV_2m_AD     =
    quote(Age12m + Age12m.GenotypeAD),
  sEV_12m_AD_vs_sEV_12m_Ctrl  =
    quote(GenotypeAD + Age12m.GenotypeAD),
  mEV_2m_Ctrl_vs_sEV_2m_Ctrl  =
    quote(EVsmEV - EVssEV),
  mEV_2m_AD_vs_sEV_2m_AD      =
    quote((EVsmEV - EVssEV) + EVsmEV.GenotypeAD),
  mEV_12m_Ctrl_vs_sEV_12m_Ctrl=
    quote((EVsmEV - EVssEV) + EVsmEV.Age12m),
  mEV_12m_AD_vs_sEV_12m_AD    =
    quote((EVsmEV - EVssEV) + EVsmEV.Age12m +
            EVsmEV.GenotypeAD + EVsmEV.Age12m.GenotypeAD),
  mEV_2m_AD_vs_mEV_2m_Ctrl     =
    quote(GenotypeAD + EVsmEV.GenotypeAD),
  mEV_12m_Ctrl_vs_mEV_2m_Ctrl  =
    quote(Age12m + EVsmEV.Age12m),
  mEV_12m_AD_vs_mEV_2m_AD      =
    quote(Age12m + EVsmEV.Age12m + Age12m.GenotypeAD + EVsmEV.Age12m.GenotypeAD),
  mEV_12m_AD_vs_mEV_12m_Ctrl   =
```

# DATA PREPARATION

## Import and Preprocess the Data
```{r dataImportation, echo=FALSE}
# Path for own mouse Brain EVs data
proteomicsBrainEVData = "./Data/OriginalData/OriginalData_MouseBrainEVs.xlsx"

# Path for published Human EVs data
proteomicsHumanData = "./Data/OriginalData/PMID_X_HumanEVs.tsv"

# Import the input data sets
brainEVData = t(read_excel(proteomicsBrainEVData, col_names = FALSE))

humanData = t(read.delim(proteomicsHumanData, header=FALSE))

# Extract the metadata (variables) from the input data sets
metaProtDataBrainEV = createMetaData(brainEVData, col_range_BrainEVData,
                                     row_range_BrainEVData,
                                     sampleNameColumns,
                                     metaColNames_BrainEVData)

metaProtDataHuman = createMetaData(humanData, col_range_HumanData,
                                   row_range_HumanData,
                                   sampleNameColumns,
                                   metaColNames_HumanData)

# Transform variables to factors and level them
metaProtDataBrainEV = relevelMetaData(metaProtDataBrainEV,
                                      relevelVariables_BrainEVData)

metaProtDataHuman = relevelMetaData(metaProtDataHuman,
                                    relevelVariables_HumanData)

# Generate the expDesign data frames
expDesignBrainEV = createExpDesign(metaProtDataBrainEV,
                                   relevelVariables_BrainEVData)
expDesignHuman = createExpDesign(metaProtDataHuman,
                                 relevelVariables_HumanData)

# Generate the proteomic data frames
protDataBrainEV = createProteinData(brainEVData,
                                    proteinNameColumns, col_range_BrainEVData)

protDataHuman = createProteinData(humanData,
                                  proteinNameColumns, col_range_HumanData)
```

# Translate the human protein nomenclature to mouse protein nomenclature in the
# published human EVs data
```{r human2mouse, echo=FALSE}
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name = protDataBrainEV$Ids[
  match(protDataHuman$Ids,protDataBrainEV$Primary.Gene.name)]
missingProteinsChar = protDataBrainEV$Primary.Gene.name[
  !protDataBrainEV$Ids %in% protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name]
missingProteins = map_lgl(protDataBrainEV$Primary.Gene.name, function(x) {
  any(map_lgl(missingProteinsChar, ~ grepl(.x, x, fixed = TRUE)))})
missingProteinsIdx = which(missingProteins %in% TRUE)
humanDataEntrezNames = unlist(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                                     protDataHuman$Ids, "ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"))
humanData2mouseNames = homologene(as.numeric(humanDataEntrezNames),
                                  inTax =9606, outTax = 10090)

for(i in missingProteinsIdx){
  geneSymbol = protDataBrainEV$Primary.Gene.name[i]
  idx_match = which(tolower(humanData2mouseNames$'10090') == tolower(geneSymbol))
  if(length(idx_match) > 0){
    idx_match = idx_match[1]
    newSymbol = humanData2mouseNames$`9606`[idx_match]
    brain_idx = which(protDataHuman$Ids == newSymbol)
    if(length(brain_idx) > 0){
      protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[brain_idx] = protDataBrainEV$Ids[i]
    }
  }
}

protDataHuman = protDataHuman[ !is.na(protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name), ]
protDataHumanSymbols = protDataHuman$Ids
protDataHuman$Ids = protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name = protDataHumanSymbols
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "P07759"] = "SERPINA3K"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "P17897"] = "LYZ1"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "P21447"] = "ABCB1A"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "P29391"] = "FTL1"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "P30275"] = "CKMT1"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "P85094"] = "ISOC2A"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "P99024"] = "TUBB5"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "Q00612"] = "G6PDX"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "Q00897"] = "SERPINA1D"
protDataHuman$Primary.Gene.name[protDataHuman$Ids == "Q9D154"] = "SERPINB1A"
```

# ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS

## Process the data for hybdrid analysis
```{r DEPProcessing, echo=FALSE}
# Format the proteomics data for DEP analysis
proteins_unique_BrainEV = make_unique(protDataBrainEV, primaryProteinID,
                                      secondaryProteinID, delim = ";")
dataColumns_BrainEV = grep(samplesIdentifier, colnames(protDataBrainEV))
proteins_unique_BrainEV[, dataColumns_BrainEV]= 
  proteins_unique_BrainEV[, dataColumns_BrainEV] %>%
  mutate(across(colnames(proteins_unique_BrainEV[, dataColumns_BrainEV]),
                ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

proteins_unique_Human = make_unique(protDataHuman, primaryProteinID, 
                                    secondaryProteinID, delim = ";")
dataColumns_Human = grep(samplesIdentifier, colnames(protDataHuman))
proteins_unique_Human[, dataColumns_Human]= 
  proteins_unique_Human[, dataColumns_Human] %>%
  mutate(across(colnames(proteins_unique_Human[, dataColumns_Human]), 
                ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))
```

# In vivo mitoEVs Hybrid Analysis
```{r invivomitoEVsHA, echo=FALSE}
set.seed(07021995)
resultsBrainEV = hybridProteomicsAnalysis(
  proteins_unique = proteins_unique_BrainEV,
  dataColumns = dataColumns_BrainEV,
  expDesign = expDesignBrainEV,
  relevelVariables = relevelVariables_BrainEVData,
  formulades = formulades_BrainEVData,
  contrastFormula = contrastFormula_BrainEVData,
  contrastList = contrastList_BrainEVData,
  condition_cols = c("EVs", "Age", "Genotype"),
  alphaSig = alphaSigTresholdSim,
  fcThreshold = fcTresholdSim,
  min_valid_samples = 4
)

sigProt_BrainEV_DEPPA = resultsBrainEV$SE_Combined
sigProt_BrainEV_DEP = resultsBrainEV$SE_DEP
sigProt_PA = resultsBrainEV$SE_PA
resultsProt_BrainEV_DEPPA = resultsBrainEV$Results_Combined
resultsProt_BrainEV_DEP = resultsBrainEV$results_DEP
resultsProt_BrainEV_PA = resultsBrainEV$Results_PA
write.csv(resultsProt_BrainEV_DEPPA, paste0(outputDirBrainEV,
                                            "statsData_Combined.csv"))
```

## RAW INTENSITIES SE
```{r rawIntensities, echo=FALSE}
valid_proteins_brain <- rownames(sigProt_BrainEV_DEPPA)
raw_matrix_brain <- proteins_unique_BrainEV[match(valid_proteins_brain,
                                                  proteins_unique_BrainEV$name),
                                            dataColumns_BrainEV]
raw_matrix_brain <- as.matrix(raw_matrix_brain)
rownames(raw_matrix_brain) <- valid_proteins_brain
colnames(raw_matrix_brain) <- colnames(sigProt_BrainEV_DEPPA)

sigProt_BrainEV_RAW <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(raw = raw_matrix_brain),
  colData = colData(sigProt_BrainEV_DEPPA)
)

valid_proteins_combined <- rownames(sigProt_HumanEV_DEPPA)

raw_mouse <- proteins_unique_BrainEV[match(valid_proteins_combined,
                                           proteins_unique_BrainEV$name),
                                     dataColumns_BrainEV]
raw_human <- proteins_unique_Human[match(valid_proteins_combined,
                                         proteins_unique_Human$name),
                                   dataColumns_Human]

raw_matrix_combined <- cbind(raw_human, raw_mouse)
raw_matrix_combined <- as.matrix(raw_matrix_combined)
rownames(raw_matrix_combined) <- valid_proteins_combined

raw_matrix_combined <- raw_matrix_combined[, colnames(sigProt_HumanEV_DEPPA)]

sigProt_HumanEV_RAW <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(raw = raw_matrix_combined),
  colData = colData(sigProt_HumanEV_DEPPA)
)
```

## Generate and save volcano plot
```{r VolcanoPlot, echo=FALSE}
# InVivoMitoEVs
for (z in contrastList_BrainEVData){
  reflabel = sub("(.*?)_vs_.*", "\\1", z)
  contrastlabel = sub(".*_vs_(.*)", "\\1", z)

  dir2save = paste0(outputDirBrainEV,"VolcanoPlot/Volcano_", z, ".tiff")
  tiff(filename = dir2save, width = 4500, height = 4250, res = 300)
  
  volcanoPlot = plot_volcano(sigProt_BrainEV_DEPPA, contrast = z, label_size = 8,
                             add_names = TRUE, plot = TRUE, adjusted = TRUE)
  
  volcanoPlot = volcanoPlot +
    labs(title="Volcano plot") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill= "white", alpha = 0.08) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "white", alpha = 0.08) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Not Significant" = "darkgray",
      "DEP Down"        = "darkcyan",   
      "DEP Up"          = "#D97959",  
      "PA Down"         = "#4B0082",   
      "PA Up"           = "#800000"   
    ))
  
  print(volcanoPlot)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r heatmap, echo=FALSE}
  col = colLegend,

  row_font_size = 14,

legendHeatmap_BrainEV = ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
  title = NULL,
  col_fun = colLegend,
  at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
  labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18),
  title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),

  grid_width  = unit(200, "mm")
)

                                   border = "white",
                                   grid_height = unit(1, "cm"),
                                   grid_width = unit(0, "cm"))

heatmap_BrainEV_Print <- ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_BrainEV,

                                              show_annotation_legend = TRUE,
                                              annotation_legend_list = list(separatorLeg, legendHeatmap_BrainEV),
                                              annotation_legend_side = "left")
dev.off()

clusterOutputDir <- paste0(outputDirBrainEV, "Cluster_Heatmaps_legend/")
if (!dir.exists(clusterOutputDir)) dir.create(clusterOutputDir)

is_sig <- rowData(sigProt_BrainEV_DEPPA, use.names = FALSE)$significant
filtered_BrainEV <- sigProt_BrainEV_DEPPA[is_sig, ]

clusters <- ComplexHeatmap::row_order(heatmap_BrainEV_Print)
cluster_df <- data.frame(Protein = character(), Cluster = integer(),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(clusters)) {
  cluster_idx <- clusters[[i]]
  cluster_dep <- filtered_BrainEV[cluster_idx, ]
  
  if (i == 3) {
    prot_names <- rowData(cluster_dep)$name
    keep_idx <- !grepl("^KRT", prot_names, ignore.case = TRUE)
    cluster_dep <- cluster_dep[keep_idx, ]
  }
  
  cluster_df <- rbind(cluster_df, data.frame(Protein = rowData(cluster_dep)$name,
                                             Cluster = i))
  
  dynamic_height <- max(3000, length(cluster_idx) * 60) 
  dir2save_cluster <- paste0(clusterOutputDir, "Heatmap_Cluster_", i, ".tiff")
  tiff(filename = dir2save_cluster, width = 4500, height = dynamic_height,
       res = 300)
  
  heatmap_sub <- plot_heatmap(
    cluster_dep, 
    type = "centered",
    kmeans = FALSE,
    col_limit = 140, 
    col = colLegend, 
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_font_size = 14,
    col_font_size = 14, 
    indicate = c("Group"),
    plot = FALSE, 
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    seed = 07021995,
    custom_anno_cols = list(Group = pca_colors_Brain), 
    custom_anno_labels = list(Group = pca_labels_Brain)
  ) 
  
  legendHeatmap_BrainEV = ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
    title = NULL,
    col_fun = colLegend,
    at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
    labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18),
    title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
    direction = "horizontal",
    grid_height = unit(8, "mm"),
    grid_width  = unit(200, "mm")
  )

  separatorLeg = ComplexHeatmap::Legend(title = " ",
                                    at = " ",
                                    legend_gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white",
                                                            col = "white"),
                                    border = "white",
                                    grid_height = unit(1, "cm"),
                                    grid_width = unit(0, "cm"))
  
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_sub, 
                       show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
                       annotation_legend_list = list(separatorLeg, legendHeatmap_BrainEV),
                       annotation_legend_side = "left")
  dev.off()
}

  col_font_size = 12, 
  indicate = c("Group"),
  plot = FALSE, 
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  seed = 07021995,
  custom_anno_cols = list(Group = pca_colors_Human), 
  custom_anno_labels = list(Group = pca_labels_Human)
) 

legendHeatmap_HumanEV = ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
  title = NULL, 
  col_fun = colLegendHuman,
  at = c(-3, -1.5, 0, 1.5, 3),
  labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18),
  title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  direction = "horizontal",
  grid_height = unit(8, "mm"),
  grid_width  = unit(15, "mm")
)

separatorLeg = ComplexHeatmap::Legend(title = " ",
                                   at = " ",
                                   legend_gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white",
                                                          col = "white"),
                                   border = "white",
                                   grid_height = unit(1, "cm"),
                                   grid_width = unit(0, "cm"))

heatmap_HumanEV_Print <- ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_HumanEV, 
                                              show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
                                              show_annotation_legend = TRUE, 
                                              annotation_legend_list =
                                                list(separatorLeg, legendHeatmap_HumanEV), 
                                              annotation_legend_side = "left")
dev.off()

clusterOutputDir_Human <- paste0(outputDirHuman, "Cluster_Heatmaps/")
if (!dir.exists(clusterOutputDir_Human)) dir.create(clusterOutputDir_Human)

is_sig_human <- rowData(sigProt_HumanEV_DEPPA, use.names = FALSE)$significant
filtered_HumanEV <- sigProt_HumanEV_DEPPA[is_sig_human, ]

clusters_human <- ComplexHeatmap::row_order(heatmap_HumanEV_Print)
cluster_df_human <- data.frame(Protein = character(), Cluster = integer(),
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(clusters_human)) {
  cluster_idx <- clusters_human[[i]]
  cluster_dep <- filtered_HumanEV[cluster_idx, ]
  cluster_df_human <- rbind(cluster_df_human,
                            data.frame(Protein = rowData(cluster_dep)$name,
                                       Cluster = i))
  
  dynamic_height <- max(2000, length(cluster_idx) * 40) 
  dir2save_cluster <- paste0(clusterOutputDir_Human,
                             "Heatmap_Cluster_", i, ".tiff")
  tiff(filename = dir2save_cluster, width = 5000,
       height = dynamic_height, res = 300)
  
  heatmap_sub <- plot_heatmap(
    cluster_dep, 
    type = "centered",
    kmeans = FALSE,         
    col_limit = 300,        
    col = colLegendHuman,       
    show_row_names = TRUE,  
    row_font_size = 9,     
    col_font_size = 9, 
    indicate = c("Group"),
    plot = FALSE, 
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    seed = 07021995,
    custom_anno_cols = list(Group = pca_colors_Human), 
    custom_anno_labels = list(Group = pca_labels_Human)    
  ) 
  
  legendHeatmap_HumanEVSub = ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
    title = NULL,
    col_fun = colLegend,
    at = c(-3, -1.5, 0, 1.5, 3),
    labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18),
    title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
    direction = "horizontal",
    grid_height = unit(8, "mm"),
    grid_width  = unit(200, "mm")
  )

    separatorLeg = ComplexHeatmap::Legend(title = " ",
                                    at = " ",
                                    legend_gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white",
                                                            col = "white"),
                                    border = "white",
                                    grid_height = unit(1, "cm"),
                                    grid_width = unit(0, "cm"))
  
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_sub, 
                       show_heatmap_legend = FALSE, 
                       annotation_legend_list = list(separatorLeg, legendHeatmap_HumanEVSub), 
                       annotation_legend_side = "left")
  dev.off()
}

lista_clusters_HumanEV<-lapply(ComplexHeatmap::row_order(heatmap_HumanEV_Print),

})
```

```{r ESRanking, echo=FALSE}
contrastES_BrainEV = calculateES(resultsProt_BrainEV_DEPPA,

                               ID, contrastList_HumanData)

contrastEntrez_BrainEV = translate_ID(resultsProt_BrainEV_DEPPA$ID,
                                      "UNIPROT",
                                      "ENTREZID",
                                      species_db = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                      manual_map = translatorMsUni2MsEn,
                                      oriESData="_ES",
                                      contrastList = contrastList_BrainEVData,
                                      contrastESData = contrastES_BrainEV) 
contrastEntrez_Human =  translate_ID(resultsProt_HumanEV_DEPPA$ID,
                                     "UNIPROT",
                                     "ENTREZID",
                                     species_db = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                     manual_map = translatorMsUni2MsEn,
                                     oriESData="_ES",
                                     contrastList = contrastList_HumanData,
                                     contrastESData = contrastES_Human) 

universe_ALLENTREZ =  translate_ID(resultsProt_HumanEV_DEPPA$ID,
                                      "UNIPROT",
                                      "ENTREZID",
                                      species_db = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                      manual_map = translatorMsUni2MsEn,
                                      oriESData="_ES")

universe_ENTREZ = universe_ALLENTREZ$`10090_ENTREZID`

metaDataSetsEntrez = list()
for (dataset_name in names(metaDataSets)){
  dataTemp = metaDataSets[[dataset_name]]
  dataTempFormatted <- stringr::str_to_title(dataTemp)
  dataTempEntrez = translate_ID(dataTempFormatted,
                                "SYMBOL",
                                "ENTREZID",
                                species_db = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                manual_map = translatorMsUni2MsEn)
  NAValues = is.na(dataTempEntrez$`10090_ENTREZID`)
  if (any(NAValues)) {
      dataTempEntrez$`10090_ENTREZID`[NAValues] <- translatorMs2Hu$`10090_ID`[
        match(tolower(dataTempEntrez$original[NAValues]), 
              tolower(translatorMs2Hu$`10090`))
      ]
    }
  metaDataSetsEntrez[[dataset_name]] = dataTempEntrez$`10090_ENTREZID`
}
```

## CUSTOM TERM DATABASES

# Translate all the proteins IDs
```{r translateTotal, echo=FALSE}
# Translate all the proteins IDs
contrastsTranslator_BrainEV = translatorDb(resultsProt_BrainEV_DEPPA$ID)
contrastsTranslator_HumanEV = translatorDb(resultsProt_HumanEV_DEPPA$ID)

# Translate the databases
HPAdf  = read.delim("./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/HPA_subcellular_location.tsv",)
subcellIds = HPAdf$Gene.name
transHPAdf = translatorHumanSym(subcellIds)

proteomo_df = read_excel("./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/PMID_39742809_ProteomoDB.xlsx",
                         sheet = "subcell_annotation_summary")
proteomo_expanded = proteomo_df %>% separate_rows(`Majority protein IDs`,
                                                  sep = ";")
proteomoIds = proteomo_expanded$`Majority protein IDs`
transProteomo = translatorHumanUni(proteomoIds)

uniprot_df  = read.delim("./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/UNIPROTkb_taxonomy_id_9606_2025_03_12.tsv")
uniprotIds = uniprot_df$Entry
transuniprot = translatorHumanUni(uniprotIds)

mitocarta_df = read_excel("./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/Mouse_MitoCarta3_Location.xls", 
             sheet = "A Mouse MitoCarta3.0")

mitocartaIds = data.frame(`10090_ENTREZID` = mitocarta_df$MouseGeneID,
                          `9606_ENTREZID` = mitocarta_df$HumanOrthologGeneID,
                          `10090_SYMBOL` = mitocarta_df$Symbol, 
                          check.names = FALSE)

mitocartaIdsTranslate = translatorMitoCarta(mitocartaIds)
mitocartaIdsTranslate[mitocartaIdsTranslate == "NULL"] = NA

HPA_cell_type_df = read.delim("./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/HPA_rna_single_nuclei_cluster_type.tsv")
HPA_brain_cluster_df = read.delim("./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/HPA_rna_single_nuclei_brain_cluster.tsv")
rnaIds = unique(c(HPA_cell_type_df$Gene.name, HPA_brain_cluster_df$Gene.name))
transRnaHPA = translatorHumanSym(rnaIds)

translatorALL = bind_rows(contrastsTranslator_BrainEV,
                          contrastsTranslator_HumanEV,
                          transHPAdf, 
                          transProteomo, 
                          transuniprot, 
                          mitocartaIdsTranslate, 
                          transRnaHPA)

translatorALLUnique = translatorALL %>% distinct(`10090_ENTREZID`, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

# Custom Mitocarta pathway database
```{r MitoPath, echo=FALSE}
# Create MitoCarta Pathways database
mitoCartaPath = read_excel(
  "./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/Mouse_MitoCarta3_Pathways.xls",
  sheet = "C MitoPathways")
mitoCartaPathLong = mitoCartaPath %>% 
  separate_rows(Genes, sep = ",\\s*") %>%  
  dplyr::select(Gene = Genes, MitoPathway)
translatorMsSym2MsEntrez = data.frame("SYMBOL" = mitocartaIdsTranslate$`10090_SYMBOL`,
                                      "ENTREZID" = mitocartaIdsTranslate$`10090_ENTREZID`)
mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez = translate_ID(mitoCartaPathLong$Gene, "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID",
                                           source_taxon = 10090, target_taxon = 10090,
                                         species_db = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                        manual_map = translatorMsSym2MsEntrez)
mitoCartaPathLong$mEntrez = mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez$`10090_ENTREZID`[match(mitoCartaPathLong$Gene,
                                                                            mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez$original)]
mitoCartaPathLong$mEntrez = mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez$`10090_ENTREZID`
MitoCartaPathLongEntrez = mitoCartaPathLong
names(MitoCartaPathLongEntrez)[names(MitoCartaPathLongEntrez) == "MitoPathway"] = "Location"
MitoCartaPathLongEntrez = MitoCartaPathLongEntrez %>% filter(!is.na(mEntrez))
gene_setsMitoPath = MitoCartaPathLongEntrez %>% 
  group_by(Location) %>% 
  summarise(genes = list(unique(mEntrez))) %>%
  deframe()

mitoCartaPath2 = read_excel(
  "./Data/Data2CustomTermsDatabases/Mouse_MitoCarta3_Pathways_SecondCategory.xls",
  sheet = "C MitoPathways")
mitoCartaPathLong2 = mitoCartaPath2 %>% 
  separate_rows(Genes, sep = ",\\s*") %>%  
  dplyr::select(Gene = Genes, MitoPathway)
translatorMsSym2MsEntrez = data.frame("SYMBOL" = mitocartaIdsTranslate$`10090_SYMBOL`,
                                      "ENTREZID" = mitocartaIdsTranslate$`10090_ENTREZID`)
mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez2 = translate_ID(mitoCartaPathLong2$Gene, "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID",
                                           source_taxon = 10090, target_taxon = 10090,
                                         species_db = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                         manual_map = translatorMsSym2MsEntrez)
mitoCartaPathLong2$mEntrez = mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez2$`10090_ENTREZID`[match(mitoCartaPathLong2$Gene,
                                                                              mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez2$original)]
mitoCartaPathLong2$mEntrez = mitoCartaPathLongmEntrez2$`10090_ENTREZID`
MitoCartaPathLongEntrez2 = mitoCartaPathLong2
names(MitoCartaPathLongEntrez2)[names(MitoCartaPathLongEntrez2) == "MitoPathway"] = "Location"
MitoCartaPathLongEntrez2 = MitoCartaPathLongEntrez2 %>% filter(!is.na(mEntrez))
gene_setsMitoPath2 = MitoCartaPathLongEntrez2 %>% 
  group_by(Location) %>% 
  summarise(genes = list(unique(mEntrez))) %>%
  deframe()
```

```{r KEGG, echo=FALSE}

genes2remove = c("P02535", "P04104", "Q3TTY5", "Q3UV17", "Q61781", 
                        "Q6IFX2", "Q6NXH9", "Q8VED5", "Q922U2", "Q9Z2K1",

contrastES_BrainEV$mEV_12m_AD_vs_mEV_2m_AD_ES =
  contrastES_BrainEV$mEV_12m_AD_vs_mEV_2m_AD_ES[!names(contrastES_BrainEV$mEV_12m_AD_vs_mEV_2m_AD_ES) %in% genes2remove]

BiocParallel::register(BiocParallel::SerialParam())
KEGGEnrichment_BrainEV = runEnrichmentAnalysis(contrastES_BrainEV,
                                                databases = "KEGG",
                                                out_dir =
                                                  paste0(outputDirBrainEV,
                                                         "/KEGG/"),
                                                OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                                organism = "mmu",
                                                keyType = "uniprot",
                                                minGSSize = 3,
                                                maxGSSize = 30000,
                                                pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                                                pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                                                verbose = FALSE,
                                                nPermSimple = 100000,
                                                eps = 0.00000001,
                                                adjpval = TRUE,
                                                widthValue = 3750, 
                                                heightValue = 4250,
                                                base_size = 25)

for (contrast in names(KEGGEnrichment_BrainEV)) {
  enrich_df_gsea <- KEGGEnrichment_BrainEV[[contrast]][["KEGG"]]$df
  if (!is.null(enrich_df_gsea) && nrow(enrich_df_gsea) > 5) {
    enrich_df_adapted <- enrich_df_gsea %>%
      dplyr::rename(geneID = core_enrichment) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Count = stringr::str_count(geneID, "/") + 1)
    cluster_out_dir <- paste0(outputDirBrainEV, "KEGG_Clusters_GSEA/", contrast, "/")
    tryCatch({
      cluster_results <- analyzeEnrichmentTermsclustersGSEA(
        enrich_df = enrich_df_adapted,
        p_adjust_thresh = 0.05,
        count_thresh = 3,
        minClusterSize = 3,
        plot_sim_thresh = 0.2,
        similarity_method = "overlap",
        overlap_metric = "jaccard",
        output_dir = cluster_out_dir,
        max_keywords = 7,
        use_wordcloud = FALSE,       
        titledotplot = paste("KEGG GSEA Clusters -", contrast)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("Skipping '", contrast, "':", e$message))
    })
  }
}
```

```{r GO_BP, echo=FALSE}
    geom_point(aes(size = n_terms, fill = mean_minusLog10_padj, alpha = mean_sim), 
               shape = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) + 
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = "Mean NES",
         title = NULL) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20), size = 20, face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 2),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black",  face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 4)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, angle = 90, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.box = "horizontal",         
        legend.box.just = "center",         
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
        plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm")
      ) +
      scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.5, 1), name = "Similarity") +
      guides(
        fill = guide_colorbar(
          title = "-log10(Adj p)",
          title.hjust = 0.5,
          title.theme = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          barwidth = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          barheight = unit(5.7, "cm")
        ),
        size = guide_legend(
          title = "Counts",
          title.position = "top",
          title.theme = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          ncol = 1
        ),
        alpha = guide_legend(
          title = "Similarity",
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5,
          title.theme = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
          override.aes = list(size = 11.5)
        )
      ) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.4, 1), name = "Similarity") +
    scale_size(range = c(6, 12),name = "Counts",
               breaks = function(x) unique(round(seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 4)))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5), 
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2, 0.2))) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = colorRampPalette(c("#005C9A", "#A80022"))(100),
                         name = "-log10(Adj p)")

    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("Skipping '", contrast, "'. Not overlapping:", e$message))
    })
  }
}
```

```{r CellType, echo=FALSE}
subcellLocEnrich_mEV = lapply(names(metaDataSetsEntrez), function(clusterName) {
  clusterData = as.character(metaDataSetsEntrez[[clusterName]])
  clusterResult = enricher(
    gene = clusterData, 
    TERM2GENE = term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb,
    universe = as.character(universe_ENTREZ),
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
    minGSSize = 3,
    maxGSSize = 300000
  )
  if (!is.null(clusterResult) && nrow(clusterResult@result) > 0) {
    clusterResult_df = as.data.frame(clusterResult@result)
    
    write.csv(clusterResult_df, paste0(outputDirMetaAnalysis, 
                                       "GeneralCellType/", 
                                       clusterName, "_enrichment.csv"), 
              row.names = FALSE)
    clusterResultSig = subset(clusterResult_df, p.adjust < 0.05)
    
    if (nrow(clusterResultSig) > 0) {
      clusterResultSig$GeneRatio_num = sapply(clusterResultSig$GeneRatio, function(x) {
        eval(parse(text = x))
      })
      clusterResultSig_filtered = subset(clusterResultSig, GeneRatio_num > 0.00)
      clusterResultPlot = clusterResult
      clusterResultPlot@result = clusterResultSig_filtered
      if (nrow(clusterResultSig_filtered) > 0) {
        dir2save = paste0(outputDirMetaAnalysis, 
                          "GeneralCellType/", 
                          clusterName, "_enrichment.tiff")
        tiff(filename = dir2save, width = 4000, height = 4250, res = 300)
        d = dotplot(clusterResultPlot,
                    showCategory = 20,
                    title = paste("Enrichment -", clusterName)) +
          aes(fill = p.adjust) +
          labs(title = "Cell Type") +
          theme_void() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 45, hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 0.5)),
                axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30),
                axis.title.x = element_text(size = 45, face = "bold", margin = margin(t=5)),
                title = element_text(size = 45, face = "bold"),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 35),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 35, margin = margin(b = 20)),
                legend.position = "right",
                legend.box.just = "center",
                legend.title.align = 0.5,
                legend.spacing.y = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                legend.box.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
                legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm")) +
          guides(color = guide_colorbar(
            title = "Adj p", 
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            label.theme = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
          ),
          size = guide_legend(
            title = "Counts",
            title.position = "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            ncol = 1,
            label.theme = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
          )) +
          annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf,
                   ymax = Inf, fill = "dimgray", alpha = 0.1) +
          annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf,
                   ymax = Inf, fill = "#870052", alpha = 0.1) +
          coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
          scale_size(range = c(15, 25)) +
          scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 70)) + 
          scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5), breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.25)) +
          scale_fill_gradientn(
            colours = colorRampPalette(c("darkgreen", "#4F0433"))(100),
            name = "Adj p")
        print(d)
        dev.off()
      }
    }
    return(clusterResult_df)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})
```

# CellType
```{r CellType, echo=FALSE}
db_original <- proteomicsBrainCellTypeDb

mapeo <- list(
  "Neurons" = c("amygdala excitatory", "cerebellar inhibitory", "cge interneuron", 
                "deep-layer corticothalamic and 6b", "deep-layer intratelencephalic", 
                "deep-layer near-projecting", "eccentric medium spiny neuron", 
                "hippocampal ca1-3", "hippocampal ca4", "hippocampal dentate gyrus", 
                "lamp5-lhx6 and chandelier", "lower rhombic lip", "mammillary body", 
                "medium spiny neuron", "mge interneuron", "midbrain-derived inhibitory", 
                "thalamic excitatory", "upper rhombic lip", "upper-layer intratelencephalic"),
  
  "Astroglia" = c("astrocyte", "bergmann glia"),
  
  "Oligodendroglia" = c("committed oligodendrocyte precursor", 
             "oligodendrocyte", "oligodendrocyte precursor cell"),
  
  "Microglia" = c("central nervous system macrophage"),
  
  "Leukocyte" = c("leukocyte"),
  
  "Pericyte" = c("pericyte"),
  
  "Choroid plexus" = c("choroid plexus epithelial cell"),
  
  "Ependymal cell" = c("ependymal cell"),
  
  "Vascular unit" = c("endothelial cell", "fibroblast",
                                    "vascular associated smooth muscle cell"),
  
  "Other" = c("miscellaneous", "splatter")
)

db_general <- list()

for (categoria in names(mapeo)) {
  tipos_especificos <- mapeo[[categoria]]
  tipos_presentes <- intersect(tipos_especificos, names(db_original))
  if(length(tipos_presentes) > 0) {
    valores_combinados <- unique(unlist(db_original[tipos_presentes],
                                        use.names = FALSE))
    db_general[[categoria]] <- valores_combinados
  }
}
```

```{r SubCell, echo=FALSE}
  label_threshold = 3.2, 
  min_threshold = 3.2, 
  gene_sets_Title = "SubCellularLocation",
  out_dir  = paste0(outputDirHuman, "SubCellularLocation/"),
  legendSize = 25,
  is_log2 = FALSE)

pre_term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb = stack(proteomicsLocalizationDb)
term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb = data.frame(
  term = pre_term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb$ind,
  gene = as.character(pre_term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb$values)
)
SubCellularLocationEnrich_mEV = lapply(names(metaDataSetsEntrez), function(clusterName) {
  clusterData = as.character(metaDataSetsEntrez[[clusterName]])
  clusterResult = enricher(
    gene = clusterData, 
    TERM2GENE = term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb,
    universe = as.character(universe_ENTREZ),
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
    minGSSize = 3,
    maxGSSize = 300000
  )
  if (!is.null(clusterResult) && nrow(clusterResult@result) > 0) {
    clusterResult_df = as.data.frame(clusterResult@result)
    
    write.csv(clusterResult_df, paste0(outputDirMetaAnalysis, 
                                       "SubCellularLocation/", 
                                       clusterName, "_enrichment.csv"), 
              row.names = FALSE)
    clusterResultSig = subset(clusterResult_df, p.adjust < 0.05)
    
    if (nrow(clusterResultSig) > 0) {
      clusterResultSig$GeneRatio_num = sapply(clusterResultSig$GeneRatio, function(x) {
        eval(parse(text = x))
      })
      clusterResultSig_filtered = subset(clusterResultSig, GeneRatio_num > 0.00)
      clusterResultPlot = clusterResult
      clusterResultPlot@result = clusterResultSig_filtered
      if (nrow(clusterResultSig_filtered) > 0) {
        dir2save = paste0(outputDirMetaAnalysis, 
                          "SubCellularLocation/", 
                          clusterName, "_enrichment.tiff")
        tiff(filename = dir2save, width = 2700, height = 2000, res = 300)
        d = dotplot(clusterResultPlot,
                    showCategory = 20,
                    title = paste("Enrichment -", clusterName)) +
          aes(fill = p.adjust) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50",
                     linewidth = 1) + 
          labs(title = NULL) +
          theme_void() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 38, hjust = 0.5,
                                           margin = margin(r = 10)),
                axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
                axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold",
                                            margin = margin(t=5)),
                title = element_text(size = 45, face = "bold"),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 25, hjust = 0.5,),
                legend.position = "right",
                legend.box.just = "center",
                legend.title.align = 0.5,
                legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
                #legend.box.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
                #legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
                panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA,
                                            linewidth = 2),
                plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm")) +
          guides(
            fill = guide_colorbar(
            title = "Adj p", 
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            title.theme = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            barwidth = unit(0.4, "cm"),
            barheight = unit(2.8, "cm"),
            label.theme = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
          ),
          size = guide_legend(
            title = "Counts",
            title.position = "top",
            title.theme = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            ncol = 1,
            label.theme = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
          )) +
          #annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "dimgray", alpha = 0.1) +
          #annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#870052", alpha = 0.1) +
          scale_size(range = c(12, 22),
                     breaks = function(x) unique(round(seq(min(x), max(x),
                                                           length.out = 4)))) +
          scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10)) + 
          scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
                             expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.2)),
                             breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
          scale_fill_gradientn(
            colours = colorRampPalette(c("#A80022", "#005C9A"))(100),
            name = "Adj p")
        print(d)
        dev.off()
      }
    }
    return(clusterResult_df)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})
```

```{r MitoPathDet, echo=FALSE}
  sigProtID = "10090_SYMBOL", 
  gene_setsID = "10090_ENTREZID", 
  label_threshold = 3, 
  min_threshold = 0, 
  gene_sets_Title = "MitochondriaPathway2",
  out_dir  = paste0(outputDirHuman, "MitoPathway2/"),
  legendSize = 2,
  is_log2 = FALSE)

pre_term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb = stack(gene_setsMitoPath2)
term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb = data.frame(
  term = pre_term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb$ind,
  gene = as.character(pre_term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb$values)
)
MitoCartaPathDetEnrich_mEV = lapply(names(metaDataSetsEntrez), function(clusterName) {
  clusterData = as.character(metaDataSetsEntrez[[clusterName]])
  clusterResult = enricher(
    gene = clusterData, 
    TERM2GENE = term2gene_proteomicsLocalizationDb,
    universe = as.character(universe_ENTREZ),
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
    minGSSize = 3,
    maxGSSize = 300000
  )
  if (!is.null(clusterResult) && nrow(clusterResult@result) > 0) {
    clusterResult_df = as.data.frame(clusterResult@result)
    
    write.csv(clusterResult_df, paste0(outputDirMetaAnalysis, 
                                       "MitoPathway2/", 
                                       clusterName, "_enrichment.csv"), 
              row.names = FALSE)
    clusterResultSig = subset(clusterResult_df, p.adjust < 0.05)
    
    if (nrow(clusterResultSig) > 0) {
      clusterResultSig$GeneRatio_num = sapply(clusterResultSig$GeneRatio, function(x) {
        eval(parse(text = x))
      })
      clusterResultSig_filtered = subset(clusterResultSig, GeneRatio_num > 0.00)
      clusterResultPlot = clusterResult
      clusterResultPlot@result = clusterResultSig_filtered
      if (nrow(clusterResultSig_filtered) > 0) {
        dir2save = paste0(outputDirMetaAnalysis, 
                          "MitoPathway2/", 
                          clusterName, "_enrichment.tiff")
        tiff(filename = dir2save, width = 4000, height = 4250, res = 300)
        d = dotplot(clusterResultPlot,
                    showCategory = 20,
                    title = paste("Enrichment -", clusterName)) +
          aes(fill = p.adjust) +
          labs(title = "Cell Type") +
          theme_void() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 45, hjust = 1,
                                           margin = margin(r = 0.5)),
                axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30),
                axis.title.x = element_text(size = 45, face = "bold",
                                            margin = margin(t=5)),
                title = element_text(size = 45, face = "bold"),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 35),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 35, margin = margin(b = 20)),
                legend.position = "right",
                legend.box.just = "center",
                legend.title.align = 0.5,
                legend.spacing.y = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                legend.box.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
                legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm")) +
          guides(color = guide_colorbar(
            title = "Adj p", 
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            label.theme = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
          ),
          size = guide_legend(
            title = "Counts",
            title.position = "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            ncol = 1,
            label.theme = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
          )) +
          annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                   fill = "dimgray", alpha = 0.1) +
          annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                   fill = "#870052", alpha = 0.1) +
          coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
          scale_size(range = c(15, 25)) +
          scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 70)) + 
          scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5), breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.25)) +
          scale_fill_gradientn(
            colours = colorRampPalette(c("darkgreen", "#4F0433"))(100),
            name = "Adj p")
        print(d)
        dev.off()
      }
    }
    return(clusterResult_df)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})
```
